subject: general
question: If it was Monday on 12th August in a particular year, then what will be the day on 26th September of the same year?
solution:
Given that:-

No of days from 12th August to 26th September = (31 -12) + 26 = 19 + 26 = **45** days. 

Since, it was **Monday **on 12th August, every 7th day from 12th August will be a Monday.

Thus, no. of odd days = 45/7 = 3.

Now, 12th August (Monday) + 3 odd days = 26th September (Thursday).

26th September will be **Thursday**.

Hence, **"option 3" **is the correct answer.
